items: Installing works when RawTherapee was downloaded in a browser: Darkroom's copy of its command-line tool no longer inherits the download's quarantine, which made macOS stop it
Darkroom checks that RawTherapee actually runs. If it can't, onboarding and Settings say so, and Repair makes a copy that works (previews and export no longer fail without a word)
A photo that fails to render is tried again later, not every second
Attaching a folder of only RAW files tells you why it made no project
Every view is the contact sheet; the grid toggle is gone
All Selects and Best Work counts in the sidebar match what the views show
The editor's busy line shows only while a photo is loading, not while an edit renders
Collections: your own bodies of work from any shoots. Press B to add the selection (or right-click, or drag onto a collection in the sidebar); drag to reorder, Delete to take a photo out
Export a collection or Best Work to a new folder (on the Desktop, named after it), with or without a frame; project screens no longer have an Export button
Best Work and All Selects show which collection each photo is in

Colour Balance in the editor: separate warmth and tint for the shadows and the highlights, for casts that differ by tone (film scans: blue-green shadows, pink highlights). Neutralize measures the cast and cancels it
Marks are the same everywhere: a Select carries its circle and Best Work its star in projects, All Selects, Best Work, collections, the loupe and the editor, in one style
Settings (⌘, or the bottom of the sidebar): turn photo analysis on or off, connect Claude Code or an Anthropic or OpenAI API key, and choose your panel
Choose a panel by style (New York Street, Colour Masters, Black-and-White Street, Documentary and Portrait, Quiet and Precise, Wit and the Absurd), or pick your own from 36 photographers
New libraries start with a short introduction; photo analysis is optional, and when it's off the Analysis button doesn't appear
Ilford HP5 Plus 400 joins the films
The sidebar follows your folders: folders first, then loose shoots; month and year folders fold away, and the one you're in opens itself
Film scans print their real camera and film on the edge, read from the roll folder ("Roll 1 - Portra 400 - M6" → LEICA M6 · PORTRA 400), not the scanner
The editor's section lines run edge to edge; its scrollbar floats over the panel while you scroll
Project covers sit inside their frame on all four sides (a taller photo ran out through the bottom)
Sidebar names and counts sit on one baseline
A new app icon: a 35 mm film frame on Baseline orange; the sidebar shows the name, Darkroom
The Export buttons are outline buttons, like Attach Folder
Edits apply faster: while you adjust, the preview renders at a lighter size, and the full-detail render follows a moment after you stop
Cleaner film strips: smaller sprocket holes, the edge print clear of the photo, and no panel behind the strips
The film edge print finds your camera even when an export dropped it, from the original file beside it (e.g. the RAF next to a Capture One export); iCloud-only files are never downloaded for this
Photos whose edited preview was cleared when the disk was full get it back in the background, so they open without waiting
Projects open as the contact sheet only; All Selects and Best Work keep the grid
The film edge print reads each photo's own camera from its EXIF (and the film simulation on a Fuji)
The edit panel no longer changes width when a section opens or a photo loads
PhotoLab is now Baseline Darkroom: same library, edits, marks and My Look, moved to the new name automatically
A new look in Baseline's design: Satoshi and Geist type, Baseline orange for primary actions and focus, framed panels
No more flashing or going black while Baseline Darkroom sits in the background: it only reloads after a real restart, and only when you come back to it
The update notice now only appears for real updates
Critique judges every photo by your own standard and what made the panel's work great
Favorite star: a simple five-point star, filled in
Before/after: drag the divider to compare the original and your edit
Sort projects, or drag them into your own order
Cleaner grease-pencil circle and star; no jitter or white boxes
New Analysis: press A to see the photo beside a critique from your panel
Every problem comes with a fix you can apply
Panel tab: the six photographers your work is judged against
No marks in Selects and Best Work
One star everywhere
Film strips are the default view
Cleaner library header
Claude critiques only use your personal account
Analysis by Claude: press A for a critique of the photo
Analysis on the photo: press A for a short read of the frame
Analysis lists things worth a second look: signs, echoes, colour rhymes
Mark buttons always in the same order: pick, favorite, reject
My Look now learns from your favorites: edit your Best Work and unedited photos follow
Update notes show what changed before you reload
Best tags removed from photos; bursts keep their line
Project menu on All Selects and Best Work
Bold marks restored inside projects
Section headers aligned
All Selects and Best Work look like project galleries
Calmer marks on All Selects; none on Best Work
Copy tightened across the app
Contact sheet is dark only
Smoother preview while editing
Less flicker in the app
Thumbnails can no longer go missing
